name: Milfy Pomme Dering
original_name: ミルフィ･ポム･デリング
source:
Cheeky, arrogant princess of the military state of Islia.
She has grown up in her warm, dry castle without knowing any hardships, and her attitude is every bit as childish as her appearance.
Her petite frame and tiny limbs allow our hero to keep her from approaching him simply by holding his hand out against her head.
She wears a small crown on her head, a possession of her mother's, and is ordinarily quite haughty and arrogant while wearing it, but becomes docile when it is taken off.
After Ataru offers her a donut, telling her, "Your name sounds like a donut, after all," she falls completely in love with them.
She loves anime, and learned the Nipponese language by watching it.
While watching one particular robot anime, she mused, "These Nipponese robot animes are all made as a reflection of reality, aren't they? Like, you can't just make up a story that realistic."
Thanks to that gross misunderstanding on her part, she is obsessed with having a bipedal robot as the ultimate weapon to aid in her nation's arms buildup.

"That's Nippon for ya! Being able to watch anime in real time is, like, the best thing ever♪"
